data_sources.role: System of record — sole data store for the application (no evidence of any secondary datastore, cache, or external DB in this codebase)
data_sources.connection: CODE-ONLY — no connection string found anywhere in Layer 1 config.json (connection_strings: []); no tnsnames.ora/docker-compose.yml in repo. Oracle Forms apps of this era typically resolve TNS aliases from an Oracle client install (tnsnames.ora) outside the source repo — not something a source-code scan can recover. UNKNOWN — reason: connection details live outside the scanned codebase (client-side TNS config, not app config).
data_sources.access_pattern: Oracle Forms 12c client (.fmb/.fmx) + PL/SQL packages, all direct SQL/PLSQL — no ORM, no repository layer, no data access abstraction

data_sources.finding: NONE FOUND — no caching class, no Oracle Advanced Queuing, no in-memory cache, no Coherence/TimesTen references anywhere in the scanned source. PKG_EMPLOYEE does hold global package-level state variables (g_current_user, g_current_emp_id, g_current_dept_id) which act as a per-session cache of the logged-in user's identity, scoped to the Forms session's PL/SQL engine lifetime.

data_sources.role: Application-level queue table (STATUS: PENDING/SENT/FAILED/CANCELLED, RETRY_COUNT) — polled by PKG_NOTIFICATION.process_queue every 5 minutes via DBMS_SCHEDULER. Dispatched via UTL_SMTP (NOT UTL_MAIL) to hard-coded smtp.internal.company.com:25. Batch size: 50 per run. Max retries: 3.
data_sources.smtp_config: HARD-CODED in PKG_NOTIFICATION.pkb constants (not read from SYSTEM_PARAMETERS at runtime — RC-004)

data_sources.kill_switch: SYSTEM_PARAMETERS GL_FEED_STATUS — consulted via PKG_COMMON.get_param before generating

data_sources.format: Fixed-width ADP format (fields: EmpNum=10, FName=30, LName=30, DOB=10, HireDate=10, Status=12, MaritalStatus=10, Gender=1, DepFName=30, DepLName=30, Relationship=20, DepDOB=10)
data_sources.kill_switch: SYSTEM_PARAMETERS BENEFITS_FEED_STATUS — NOT consulted by export_benefits_feed (A-010 security/compliance gap)
data_sources.pii_risk: Exports EMPLOYEES + EMPLOYEE_DEPENDENTS PII in plaintext without has_permission check (A-009)

data_sources.status: TODO STUB — procedure reads file lines but makes no database writes. Parsing is not implemented.
STUB placeholder — single log_info call only, no LDAP/AD connectivity

data_sources.role: DB-table-backed session tracking for Oracle Forms client sessions (LOGIN_TIME/LOGOUT_TIME/IP_ADDRESS/FORMS_MODULE/SESSION_STATUS), read/written by PKG_SECURITY (is_session_valid, authenticate, logout)

note_on_caching_cross_reference: Per skill error-handling rule ('Caching class found in */Services* → document in BOTH data-source-inventory.json AND storage-pattern-analysis.md'): no Services-layer caching class exists in this codebase at all (it is Oracle Forms + PL/SQL, not a service-oriented app), so this rule does not apply structurally. The only 'caching' behavior is PKG_EMPLOYEE's session-scoped global variables, documented in both this file and storage-pattern-analysis.md.
